issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם' is a place name (Ashtaroth-karnaim), not '亞斯他錄雙角神像' (the double-horned idol of Ashtaroth). This changes the meaning from a location to an idol.
The Hebrew 'בְּהָם' is a place name (Ham), not '含' (Ham the person, Noah's son). The Chinese renders it as a personal name, changing the location to a person.

The Hebrew 'בְּשָׁוֵה קִרְיָתַיִם' is a place name (Shaveh-kiriathaim), not '在沙威的基列亞音' (in Shaveh of Gilead-ain). The Chinese adds '基列' (Gilead) which is not in the Hebrew, and '亞音' is not a correct rendering of 'קִרְיָתַיִם' (Kiriathaim).
